svg.title: Validation: provenance and preservation testing, and the benchmark
svg.desc: Two panels. Left, provenance: algorithms extracted from the Skynet pipeline and Afterglow and ported from Astromancer, with upstream files and line ranges recorded and 40 EXTRACTED and 53 PORTED markers, and deliberate corrections tested against independent references; 2,317 test functions pin parity with recorded upstream output, known bugs included; continuous integration on Python 3.12 and 3.13 against the lockfile with secret scanning and a workflow audit; and a release path from TestPyPI through a byte-compared install to PyPI by trusted publishing. Right, evaluation: tasks with answer keys run through the same loop with astronomy services replayed, graded deterministically and separately from running; the September 2026 sweep of 144 sessions scored 88%, 85%, 53% correct. A dashed box marks Aim 3's proposed extension to real Skynet 2 observations, with failures traced to instrument, execution, analysis or AI interpretation.
